entries.description: Recorded the E5 result immediately on budget exhaustion, before any decision about continuing, and wrote that continuing requires a NEW pre-registration rather than a continuation. No error existed. The pre-registered bar is what made the boundary visible as a boundary.

Declined to begin phase 26 on a generic 'proceed'. No error existed — the instruction was ordinary. But E5's budget was exhausted and the protocol recorded 20 minutes earlier that continuing requires a NEW countersigned pre-registration; reading 'proceed' as that countersignature would be the bar moving at the moment it binds. The pre-registered boundary is what made an ordinary instruction visible as a boundary crossing.

findings.description: E5 complete: 8/8 sessions, matrix 11/25 -> 18/25, 7 cells + 2 predicates. Bar cleared on both arms. The general-depth 1/x notin EML claim remains open — the matrix is the instrument, not the claim.
